title: Weighted central additive fppf extension datum
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme]. For an $S$-scheme $T$, put $\mathbf G_a(T)=(\Gamma(T,\mathcal O_T),+)$ and $\mathbf G_m(T)=\Gamma(T,\mathcal O_T)^\times$, with restrictions induced by pullback of global sections. Let $Z$ be a group object in schemes over $S$, and let $k\in\mathbb Z$. A weighted additive extension datum is a group-valued functor $F$ on $S$-schemes with unique gluing for jointly surjective flat locally finitely presented covering families, natural group homomorphisms $i:Z(-)\to F$ and $q:F\to\mathbf G_a$, and the following conditions: $i$ is injective on every test scheme and its image is exactly the kernel of $q$; $q$ is locally surjective for the fppf topology; $i(Z)$ commutes with every section of $F$; there is an action $\alpha_T:\mathbf G_m(T)\to\operatorname{Aut}(F(T))$ by group automorphisms, natural under every morphism of test schemes, with $\alpha_T(t)(i(z))=i(z)$ and $q(\alpha_T(t)(x))=t^kq(x)$. These data impose no representability of $F$, no commutativity on $F$, and no restriction on the characteristic or on $k$.
